audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose named no cooldowns; Shunpo (12/11/10/9/8) and Death Lotus (75/60/45) are what the step-up timing actually keys on.
audit.why: Katarina's whole threat is Shunpo availability and whether Voracity has refunded it.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[2].why and breakdown.feeding now carry the numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were unstated: Death Lotus applies Grievous Wounds, which cuts the Bladesurge heal your sustain plan rests on; and Voracity refunds her cooldowns off any nearby champion death, so a kill anywhere resets her.
audit.why: Both change when you are allowed to commit. The channel-cancel interaction was present but only in the content layer.
audit.corrected: Added to enemyWin, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.feeding.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text and late both call Defiant Dance a shield. Riot's text gives Irelia's W reduced PHYSICAL damage taken during the charge — no shield, and no mitigation of Katarina's magic damage at all.
audit.why: Katarina deals magic damage; telling the reader Defiant Dance shields her all-in is advice that gets them killed.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to say damage reduction, and the spike now leans on cancelling the channel instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side read 'Skill' while every content win[N] read 'Irelia' — seven rows where the chart and the row label disagreed.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Irelia for all seven rows and the full-layer why prose already described Irelia winning each stage; the side token was the stale layer.
audit.corrected: All seven sides moved to Irelia with ratings and whys rewritten in the same proposal; win[N] already reads Irelia so no content edit is required.

edits.before: - Katarina Shunpo: matchup-defining — Her blink to daggers and targets — hard CC during her resets and she folds. Check it before every step-up. - W Defiant Dance is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Shunpo is 12s at rank 1 and 8s at rank 5 — it is her only escape, so stun her right after she blinks in. - Bouncing Blade is 11s at rank 1 and needs a minion to bounce off. - Death Lotus is 75s at rank 1 and any hard CC cancels the channel outright.

notes: Two same-error fixes: Defiant Dance was described as a shield in spikes[3].text and late. Riot's text is reduced PHYSICAL damage taken while charging — it does not mitigate Katarina's magic damage at all, so the old advice was actively misleading. The seven-row phases[N].side='Skill' vs win[N]='Irelia' split is fixed as one atomic group. breakdown.wave and breakdown.early left templated — no Katarina-specific wave hook I could ground from the kit.
